summary: Anthropic announced an expanded agreement with Google and Broadcom for multiple gigawatts of next-generation TPU compute capacity expected to come online starting in 2027, alongside disclosure of accelerating revenue and customer growth.

mechanisms.reason: A multi-gigawatt next-generation TPU deal directly expands the compute available to train and serve frontier Claude models.
mechanisms.quote: We have signed a new agreement with Google and Broadcom for multiple gigawatts of next-generation TPU capacity that we expect to come online starting in 2027.

mechanisms.reason: Multi-gigawatt compute deployment implies a corresponding multi-gigawatt increase in datacentre power demand, sited mostly in the US.
mechanisms.quote: The vast majority of the new compute will be sited in the United States, making this partnership a major expansion of our November 2025 commitment to invest $50 billion in strengthening American computing infrastructure.

mechanisms.reason: The deal deepens use of Google's custom TPU silicon co-developed with Broadcom rather than merchant GPUs alone.
mechanisms.quote: The partnership deepens our existing work with Google Cloud—building on the increased TPU capacity we announced last October—as well as our relationship with Broadcom.

mechanisms.reason: Disclosed run-rate revenue growth and doubling of large-spend customers indicate sharply rising inference demand that the new compute is meant to serve.
mechanisms.quote: Our run-rate revenue has now surpassed $30 billion—up from approximately $9 billion at the end of 2025.

categories.reason: The deal expands deployment of Google TPUs co-designed with Broadcom, custom silicon displacing some merchant accelerator demand.
categories.quote: We have signed a new agreement with Google and Broadcom for multiple gigawatts of next-generation TPU capacity

categories.reason: Google Cloud's TPU and cloud infrastructure business gains a major expanded compute commitment from Anthropic.
categories.quote: The partnership deepens our existing work with Google Cloud—building on the increased TPU capacity we announced last October

categories.reason: The multi-gigawatt US-sited compute build-out expands datacentre hosting capacity dedicated to serving Claude.
categories.quote: The vast majority of the new compute will be sited in the United States

notable_reason: A named multi-gigawatt TPU/Broadcom compute commitment paired with disclosed revenue tripling in a year is a concrete, sector-relevant infrastructure signal worth tracking today.
